weather_evidence.note: The raw 'Weather' reason code alone understates true weather-linked disruption: 'Reactionary' (knock-on delay from an earlier flight) is consistently the largest category (~70% of reason-coded delays) and is frequently a downstream effect of an earlier weather-caused delay that gets bureaucratically recoded once it cascades. This evidence is used to substantiate that weather is a real, DGCA-documented cause of disruption - it is not used as a direct multiplier in the EV probability calculation, which instead uses the fuller all-cause monthly DGCA OTP baseline (see data_pipeline.py) precisely because that one does capture reactionary/cascading effects.
